footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to TPG: after $415M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $60.8M of preferred dividends. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 33.4% to $4.7B in 2025. Operating income rose 74.2× to $688M, a 14.7% margin.
Net income was $124M, or $0.45 per share, after a $307K loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $1.0B and free cash flow $1.0B, versus $504M.
sources: TPG Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
